cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Hope with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into believing that the outcome can still change, even when the evidence is thin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two streets rejected our parade route, not the whole town. Please rub out 'cancelled' and help me find a third.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The only route left goes behind the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then draw it properly, including the loading bay. Not a dotted line. It's a possible route until someone tells us otherwise. Who might watch there?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My dad would. He works in the warehouse.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put him by the staff entrance, clear of the parade. Good. Now put someone beside him; he won't be the only worker coming out for a look.

reason: Make A's exact planning corrections recruit B into hope while preserving the small concrete contribution of a first possible spectator.
